column1: # The server and the grammar this engine's committed answers come from.
# default pins Apache Hive 4.0.1 through a HiveServer2 with the embedded Derby
# metastore: the driver's tapes (hive/driver) and compat.tsv (hive/parser) are
# recorded against it through hive/internal/testcontainer and replayed with no
# grammar pins Apache Hive's ANTLR 3 HiveQL grammar files in vendor/*.g at the
# commit of the rel/release-4.0.1 release. The digest is the SHA-256 of those
# 10 files read in order by hive/parser/cmd/antlr3to4, which converts them into
# columns: role, image, digest, source tag
